en.home.about.title: Wu Qin Research Laboratory
en.home.about.p1: We bring together chemical biology, bioinformatics, artificial intelligence, and clinical medicine to develop original chemical probes and new omics technologies, build comprehensive cellular atlases, and open new paths to precision diagnosis and treatment.
en.home.about.p2: Over the past five years, our work has appeared in leading journals including Science, and we have conducted multicenter clinical research across China. Supported by major national research programs and advanced wet-lab and computing platforms, we connect every stage from molecular design to clinical validation.
en.home.about.p3: We believe that every spark of curiosity about the unknown within cells ( wonder for science ) can become an opportunity to transform human health ( wonder for health ). Join us, where curiosity inspires discovery and makes wonders possible.

zh.home.about.title: 吴芩课题组
zh.home.about.p1: 我们聚焦化学生物学、生物信息学、人工智能与临床医学的深度交叉，开发原创化学探针与组学新技术，绘制细胞全景图谱，推动精准诊疗新路径。
zh.home.about.p2: 近五年成果发表于 Science 等顶刊，并开展全国多中心临床研究。依托国家重大专项及先进湿实验与算力平台，从分子设计到临床验证全链条贯通。
zh.home.about.p3: 我们相信，每一次对细胞未知的好奇（ wonder for science ），都终将化为改写生命健康的契机（ wonder for health ）。加入我们，让好奇与奇迹发生。
